pattern: V1 着 V1 着 V2了
title: V1 着 V1 着 V2了 (V2’ed while V1-ing)
longExplanation: V2’ed while V1-ing. Pinyin: V1 zhe V1 zhe V2 le
formation: V1 zhe V1 zhe V2 le

examples.romanization: tā jiǎng zhe jiǎng zhe jiù xiào le。
examples.translation: As she was speaking, she started to laugh.

title: 一……就…… (as soon as … then …)
longExplanation: as soon as … then …. Pinyin: yī…… jiù……

examples.romanization: tā yī huíjiā jiù kàn diànshì。
examples.translation: As soon as she gets home, (then) she watches TV.

title: 一……就…… (每次只要)
longExplanation: 每次只要. Pinyin: yī…… jiù……

examples.sentence: 儿子小时候一说话就脸红。
examples.romanization: érzi xiǎoshíhou yī shuōhuà jiù liǎnhóng。
examples.translation: When [my] son was a child, as soon as he speaks, (then) he blushes.

examples.sentence: 究竟哪个季节去旅游比较好呢？
examples.romanization: jiūjìng nǎge jìjié qù lǚyóu bǐjiào hǎo ne？
examples.translation: Which season exactly is better to travel?

title: V 起(来) (V up)
longExplanation: V up. Pinyin: V qǐ( lái)

examples.sentence: 你先把桌子上的东西拿起(来)，我擦完之后你再放下来。
examples.romanization: nǐ xiān bǎ zhuōzi shàng de dōngxi náqǐ( lái)， wǒ cā wán zhīhòu nǐ zài fàng xiàlai。
examples.translation: You pick up the things on the table first, and then you [can] put them down after I clean it.

title: V 起来 (to start to V)
longExplanation: to start to V. Pinyin: V qilai

examples.romanization: xiǎo wáng yòu chàng qilai le。

title: V 起来 (seems like, sounds like)
longExplanation: seems like, sounds like. Pinyin: V qilai

examples.sentence: 上海话听起来就像外语一样。
examples.romanization: Shànghǎihuà tīngqilai jiù xiàng wàiyǔ yīyàng。
examples.translation: The Shanghai dialect sounds like a foreign language.

title: 说起 O (speaking of O)
longExplanation: speaking of O. Pinyin: shuōqǐ O

examples.sentence: 说起吃的东西，给我印象最深的是湖南菜。
examples.romanization: shuōqǐ chī de dōngxi， gěi wǒ yìnxiàng zuì shēn de shì Húnán cài。
examples.translation: Speaking of food, the one that impressed me the most is Hunan cuisine.

examples.sentence: 评委叫第一对夫妻说说他俩是如何恩爱的。
examples.romanization: píngwěi jiào dìyī duì fūqī shuōshuo tā liǎ shì rúhé ēn'ài de。
examples.translation: The judge called the first couple to talk about how they loved each other.
How is the monthly income situation with those born in the 80s?

examples.romanization: zěnme， nǐ bù rènshi wǒ le？！
examples.translation: What, you don't know me anymore?!

examples.sentence: 王老师喜欢靠着桌子讲课。
examples.romanization: wáng lǎoshī xǐhuan kào zhe zhuōzi jiǎngkè。
examples.translation: Teacher Wang likes to give her lecture while leaning on the table.

examples.sentence: 我的座位是17号，是靠窗的座位。
examples.romanization: wǒ de zuòwèi shì17 hào， shì kàochuāng de zuòwèi。
examples.translation: My seat is No. 17, which is (a seat) by the window.

examples.sentence: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友。
examples.romanization: zài jiā kào fùmǔ， chūmén kào péngyou。
examples.translation: At home [you] relies on [your] parents, [when you] go out [you] rely on [your] friends.

examples.sentence: 这么简单的题，你居然也不会做？
examples.romanization: zhème jiǎndān de tí， nǐ jūrán yě bùhuì zuò？
examples.translation: [For] such a simple question, [you’re telling me that] you don’t know how to do it?
